retrieval.output_policy: Write stdout to a new file outside the checkout, verify blob identity plus compressed SHA-256 before decompression, then verify raw SHA-256. No execution of restored evidence.
retrieval.publication_constraint: Retain the existing merge history including the immutable origin commit. Do not squash, rewrite or prune away the only retained object anchor.

required_typed_proof.required_capture_streams_and_candidate_m: Remain active and unchanged at their original relative paths.

honesty_boundary: Original QA verdict and artifact-index bytes remain unchanged historical records of the accepted source execution and original preservation snapshot. Their supplementary packet path now resolves through this explicit Git-history map, not as a live checkout file. This map grants no fresh QA acceptance, does not alter any required proof, and does not relabel historical results.
